title: Air conditioning not cold
purpose: Public page for the summer season: what the A/C check is, what a recharge costs for each refrigerant.
facts: Customer words "freon", "recharge" = catalogue jobs ac_recharge / ac_recharge_1234yf "A/C evacuate & recharge".
R-134a: most cars up to about 2016; R-1234yf: most from about 2017 (rule of thumb; the under-hood label decides).
An empty system has a leak; the advisor must say so before selling a recharge.
new_facts: The 2016/2017 rule of thumb for refrigerant is a designed simplification; the reference vehicles in the catalogue are a 2015 Camry (R-134a) and a 2019 CR-V (R-1234yf).
